# Data dictionary

<!-- GENERATED by `python -m retrieval.data_dictionary` from the live database. Do not edit by hand; edit retrieval/column_notes.yaml and regenerate. -->

All tables are in schema `analytics` (synthetic Indian retail data, INR). Star schema: facts `fact_orders` (one row per order) and `fact_order_items` (one row per order line); dimensions for date, region, store, customer and product.

## dim_date

One row per calendar day in the order window. Indian fiscal year (Apr-Mar).

Rows: 730. Primary key: date_key.

| column | type | meaning | example values |
|---|---|---|---|
| date_key | integer, not null | Surrogate key, the date as integer YYYYMMDD. | 20241001 … 20260930 |
| date | date, not null | Calendar date; join key for fact_orders.order_date. | 2024-10-01 … 2026-09-30 |
| day | smallint, not null | Day of month (1-31). | 1 … 31 |
| month | smallint, not null | Calendar month number (1 = January). | 1 … 12 |
| month_name | text, not null | English month name. | 'April', 'August', 'December', 'February', 'January', 'July', 'June', 'March', 'May', 'November', 'October', 'September' |
| quarter | smallint, not null | Calendar quarter (1 = Jan-Mar). Default for "Q1..Q4" questions. | 1 … 4 |
| year | smallint, not null | Calendar year. | 2024 … 2026 |
| fiscal_quarter | smallint, not null | Indian fiscal quarter (1 = Apr-Jun, 2 = Jul-Sep, 3 = Oct-Dec, 4 = Jan-Mar). | 1 … 4 |
| fiscal_year | text, not null | Indian fiscal year label (April-March), e.g. FY2026-27. | 'FY2024-25', 'FY2025-26', 'FY2026-27' |

## dim_region

Five sales regions of India.

Rows: 5. Primary key: region_id.

| column | type | meaning | example values |
|---|---|---|---|
| region_id | smallint, not null | Region identifier. | 1 … 5 |
| region_name | text, not null | Sales region name; use exactly these values in filters. | 'Central India', 'East India', 'North India', 'South India', 'West India' |
| zone | text, not null | Grouping of regions; North-Central contains North India and Central India. | 'East', 'North-Central', 'South', 'West' |

## fact_orders

Order header. channel Online/Store; status Completed/Returned/Cancelled.

Rows: 50,504. Primary key: order_id.
Join: `fact_orders.customer_id` → `dim_customer.customer_id`.
Join: `fact_orders.order_date` → `dim_date.date`.
Join: `fact_orders.store_id` → `dim_store.store_id`.

| column | type | meaning | example values |
|---|---|---|---|
| order_id | integer, not null | Order identifier (one row per order). | 1 … 50504 |
| order_date | date, not null | Date the order was placed; relative dates resolve against max(order_date). | 2024-10-01 … 2026-09-30 |
| customer_id | integer, not null | Customer who placed the order. | 1 … 5000 |
| store_id | integer, not null | Selling / fulfilling store (also set for Online orders). | 1 … 40 |
| channel | text, not null | Sales channel. | 'Online', 'Store' |
| status | text, not null | Order status; revenue KPIs count Completed only. | 'Cancelled', 'Completed', 'Returned' |

## fact_order_items

Order lines. line_revenue = quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct/100), INR.

Rows: 90,357. Primary key: order_item_id.
Join: `fact_order_items.order_id` → `fact_orders.order_id`.
Join: `fact_order_items.product_id` → `dim_product.product_id`.

| column | type | meaning | example values |
|---|---|---|---|
| order_item_id | integer, not null | Order line identifier. | 1 … 90357 |
| order_id | integer, not null | Order this line belongs to. | 1 … 50504 |
| product_id | integer, not null | Product sold on this line. | 1 … 200 |
| quantity | integer, not null | Units on this line. | 1 … 12 |
| unit_price | numeric(12,2), not null | Price per unit before discount, INR. | 69.00 … 60499.00 |
| discount_pct | numeric(5,2), not null | Discount percentage on this line (0-100 scale, e.g. 10 = 10%). | 0.00 … 40.00 |
| line_revenue | numeric(14,2), not null | Net line revenue, INR = quantity * unit_price * (1 - discount_pct/100). | 44.85 … 241996.00 |
| line_cost | numeric(14,2), not null | Line cost of goods, INR = quantity * dim_product.unit_cost. | 56.91 … 185275.92 |
